name: Dot map
oneLiner: a dot-matrix world sweeps in grey on a pane of dark glass, then region by region the dots light outward from each centre as a frosted chip counts its number up, and one region turns the accent and pulses outward twice while its chip lifts and the camera leans in
say: when the speaker says where people are or how far something reached ('most of you watch from North America', 'it spread to every continent'): cut in on the reach, the lead region pulses on the word that names it
